pattern: The runner has received a shutdown signal|lost communication with the server
why: A self-hosted or spot runner died mid-job. GitHub reports it as an annotation, and the job's log is usually gone (BlobNotFound), so the annotation is the evidence.

pattern: Mirror sync in progress|File has unexpected size \([0-9]+ != [0-9]+\)|E: Failed to fetch \S+\s+(404|502|503)
why: An Ubuntu mirror served an index or a pool file it did not have. Every apt step already retries three times, so seeing this means the mirror stayed bad for over a minute.
Launchpad answered 503 while add-apt-repository fetched a PPA for the AppImage leg.
sdkmanager downloaded a truncated SDK package before anything was built.
A fresh QEMU segfaulted at restart with an empty board console: a QEMU signal, not the board's firmware.
CPack's DMG step lost a race for the disk-image driver on a GitHub-hosted macOS runner.
